about_short_description.short_description: GoLorry provides transport and logistics services and company.

product.name: Instant Pricing
product.description: Provides immediate pricing for any route, allowing clients to book trucks, manage orders, and track trucks via the app without phone calls.

product.name: Nationwide Trucking Access
product.description: Offers access to the entire Indian trucking market, directing truckers to high-demand routes to form round trips and improve turnaround times.

product.name: Digital Payments and Records
product.description: Digitizes payments, records, and paperwork to streamline operations.

product.name: 24/7 Customer Service
product.description: Provides round-the-clock customer service to assist both clients and transporters.
